title: How can AI create a realistic image from a sentence?
sources: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models

lines.text: How can artificial intelligence take a single written sentence and generate a photo-realistic painting in ten seconds?
lines.caps: How does AI turn *words | into realistic *images?

lines.text: Modern image generators don't cut and paste pieces from Google Images.
lines.caps: AI does not *copy | and paste existing *photos!

lines.text: They use an advanced process called latent diffusion, inspired by non-equilibrium thermodynamics.
During training, the AI learns by taking millions of pictures and slowly destroying them with static pixel noise.
lines.caps: Learned by adding *static noise | to millions of *pictures

lines.text: It learns to mathematically reverse the degradation, reconstructing clean pictures from pure fuzz.
lines.caps: Learns to reverse the *noise | back into crisp *details

lines.text: When you type a prompt, the AI starts with a canvas of random television static, carving out shapes based on your words.
lines.caps: Starts with random *static | and sculpts details step by *step!

lines.text: It essentially dreams an image out of mathematical static noise.
lines.caps: AI literally dreams *reality | out of pure mathematical *noise!
